# Vid2Tweet Agent

## Description
AI agent for the Vid2Tweet project — transforms YouTube videos into tweets using Kestra orchestration.

## Capabilities
- Create and modify Kestra workflow YAML files
- Build Next.js frontend components
- Debug pipeline execution issues
- Write shell scripts for audio/video processing

## Instructions
Follow the conventions in AGENTS.md. Always use Kestra secrets for API keys. Never add global npm packages.
